title: net2 on a hit's concepts, beside the seven hand-picked LCFs
description: Step 4, third of three experiments, at m = all: net2 on the net1 of the input net1 (an experiments/concepts-net1.json release, whose concepts.md names the hit and its concepts), and, as the comparison at the same recipe, on the estimator of the seven hand-picked LCFs (exp-estimator-seven-20). net2 has the discovery decoder's shape: a GRU reading net1's beliefs (64 bins pooled into 32 per LCF) and its own previous decision, the window set over a fixed 2^7 packets (PPOSpec.window fixed), so the window in force reaches it as the previous decision and nothing measured passes around the LCFs (docs/methodology.md, retraining). Per cell, the seed search's recipe for BBRv3: 40 iterations of cloning BBRv3, 120 of reinforcement learning (learning rate 0.00003, clip 0.2, noise 0.1), BBRv3 the reference of every evaluation, the best evaluated policy kept; eight seeds (201 to 208) per set of LCFs, since few seeds of the discovery controller train well. Each cell runs its kept policy on the validation episodes of exp-teachers-val-35 (ground.py rollouts, the training links cut to one episode); collect: the training report, and each draw against BBRv3 on those episodes (experiments/versus_reference.py). Rule, fixed before any draw is scored: a draw is trained well when the whole 95% interval of its log utility minus BBRv3's lies above -0.1, alone and with a competing flow; the concepts work at m = all when a concept draw is trained well, and of the trained-well draws the one with the highest mean over both conditions is kept for the test links, read once, later. At most five cells run at once.
run: case "$LCFS" in concepts) N="$IN/net1/net1/net1.pt";; seven) N="$IN/estimator/estimator/net1.pt";; *) exit 2;; esac; R="ctl-$LCFS-s$SEED"; jq --arg net1 "$N" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.net1_from = $net1 | .algo = "clone" | .teacher_cc = "bbr3" | .action_max = 8 | .inputs = "net1" | .window = "fixed" | .share_k = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .tau_s = 1 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .reference_cc = "bbr3" | .seed = $seed | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 100 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .iterations = 40 | .eval_every = 10 | .time_budget_s = 7200' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$OUT/spec-clone-$R.json"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$OUT/spec-clone-$R.json" "$OUT/clone-$R" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; jq --arg net1 "$N" --arg from "$OUT/clone-$R" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.net1_from = $net1 | .algo = "ppo" | .init_from = $from | .action_max = 8 | .inputs = "net1" | .window = "fixed" | .share_k = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .tau_s = 1 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .reference_cc = "bbr3" | .seed = $seed | .critic_warmup = 3 | .noise_sigma = 0.1 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.00003 | .clip = 0.2 | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 8100' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$OUT/spec-rl-$R.json"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$OUT/spec-rl-$R.json" "$OUT/rl-$R" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; mkdir -p "$OUT/$R"; cp "$OUT/rl-$R/ppo_spec.json" "$OUT/rl-$R/net1.pt" "$OUT/$R/"; cp "$OUT/rl-$R/policy-best.onnx" "$OUT/$R/policy.onnx"; cp "$OUT/rl-$R/actor-best.pt" "$OUT/$R/actor.pt"; uv run python experiments/ground.py rollouts "$OUT/$R" --links 1 --fit "$OUT/setup/paths/campaign.json" --score "$OUT/setup/eval/campaign.json" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
collect: uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/rl-ctl-*; E="$(mktemp -d)"; for r in "$OUT"/ctl-*; do ln -s "$r" "$E/${r##*/}-s1"; done; uv run python experiments/versus_reference.py "$OUT/versus-bbr3" "$E"/* "$IN/teachers"/stock-*; cp "$IN/net1/concepts.md" "$OUT/"
